column1: # Black/Matrix AD - Chapter 4 Begird, White-Wing Liberation Front briefing
# No manual wrapping: patchline.py supplies pixel-aware line breaks.

column2: Everyone!
Welcome to the headquarters of our $$白き羽・解放革命戦線$$!
I never imagined the facility we heard about would be underground like this.
Hahahaha! We make use of the underground waterways, you see!
It smells a little, but you will find no safer place.
By the way, Lord $$ケルビム$$! Thank you for saving us when we were in danger,
and for treating our companion as well...
Not at all. With our facilities, this is nothing.
But that woman from before...
Her injuries aside, she seemed terribly weakened.
Ah, forgive me. Let us not pry any further.
$$ケルビム$$, tell everyone about your organization instead.
Ah, yes, of course!
We are an underground organization of white $$羽$$ people who rose up to change the dictatorial order of this $$世界$$,
and the $$奴隷$$ rule imposed by black $$羽$$ people!
What's an underground organization?
In short, in a $$世界$$ where black $$羽$$ people are strong, they cannot act openly,
so they are a group that sneaks about in the shadows.
Hahahahaha!
That is quite painful to hear!
So what does this organization actually do?
Across this entire continent, many comrades have already gathered in secret,
and are steadily preparing for the coming day of armed uprising...
Surely you too...
know well how cruelly white $$羽$$ people have been treated until now!
In other words, our ultimate goal is to establish a government led by white $$羽$$ people—
a revolutionary government...
So, if possible, we would dearly like the $$救世主$$
to join us and become the symbol of our organization!!
W-what!?
Is that not rather a leap in the discussion?
Do you know that each of the $$大邪神$$s sealed within the armor you wear
has its own history?
Though they are now called $$大邪神$$s,
until they were defeated by $$サタン$$'s side in the mythical $$創世記戦争$$,
they are said to have wielded their immense power throughout the mortal world as apostles who revered $$大邪神ゴッド$$!
Lord $$マルコ$$'s armor belongs to $$ラグエル$$, the $$大邪神$$ who extols the sky!
Lord $$レブロブス$$'s armor belongs to $$ウリエル$$, the $$自由$$-loving $$大邪神$$ who extols flame!
Lord $$ピリポ$$'s armor belongs to $$サリエル$$, the $$大邪神$$ of the $$弱者$$ who extols water!
Lord $$ガイ$$'s armor belongs to $$ミカエル$$, the $$正義$$-loving $$大邪神$$ who extols the earth!
And... the remaining armor you wear is...
that of the mysterious god with two faces: ruler of darkness and creator of all things,
the ultimate $$大善神$$... rumored to be the true identity of Lord $$サタン$$...
Lord $$メタトロン$$'s armor!!
The myths surrounding those we call gods were originally...
all tales of ancient times, impossible to verify...
so competing theories abound, and we cannot say anything for certain...
To begin with, Lord $$メタトロン$$...
is said to be the mysterious $$平等$$-loving $$大天使$$ with two faces: ruler of darkness and creator of all things...
As for who he truly was...
not even our holy scripture says anything at all...
But legend tells us this...
One who inherits $$メタトロン$$'s soul is one who bears two hearts within.
One day, that person shall appear before God's throne and surely lead the $$世界$$ in a new direction...
Moreover, the $$救世主$$s' many exploits have already become legend even among the $$奴隷$$s.
What do you say?
For the happiness of all white $$羽$$ people, would you lend your strength to our organization?
I understand the strategist's view, but Lord $$マルコ$$...
What do you honestly think of $$ケルビム$$'s opinion?
am simply doing all I can to carry on the will of my friend, our first leader!
But from what I can see, your strategist $$ケルビム$$ too
seems to be from black $$羽$$ stock like $$ルピルピ$$ and me. Why join this white $$羽$$ organization?
$$ケルビム$$ is...
the father of this organization's late first leader, who was also my dear friend...
$$セラフィム$$!
This $$邪神$$ armor is the only keepsake he left me...
